[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Indian Embroideries by John Irwin and Margaret Halliday  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Art of Indian Asia: Its Mythology and Transformations by Heinrich Zimmer  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Fabric of India by Rosemary Crill  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended workshops:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Craft Village: Located in Delhi, India, offers workshops on traditional Indian embroidery techniques such as Kantha, Chikankari, and Phulkari.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Block Printing Company: Based in Jaipur, India, offers workshops on traditional block printing techniques used in Indian textiles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Stitching Project: Located in Pushkar, India, offers workshops on Indian hand embroidery techniques such as Zardozi, Gota Patti, and Mirror Work.
